requirement: A joiner provisioning audit log tying each joiner's grants to an HR effective-start event and a named role/birthright rule, with the manual-vs-automated grant ratio and time-to-first-access against SLA.
example_artifact: e.g., a provisioning audit-log export plus the versioned birthright role-policy register

requirement: A leaver de-provisioning SLA report showing per-account termination-event timestamp to disable timestamp, percentage within SLA, breach list with root cause, and coverage across SaaS and on-prem targets.
example_artifact: e.g., a leaver SLA / de-provisioning report with the termination-to-disable distribution

requirement: An orphan-account scan plus dormant-account (inactivity) report identifying accounts with no valid owner and accounts past the inactivity threshold (e.g. 45 days), with remediation/disable actions and approvals and scan coverage of in-scope systems.
example_artifact: e.g., a reconciliation scan output listing orphan and dormant accounts with disposition

requirement: A certification campaign completion report: scope/population, item counts, percentage reviewed within window (target >=95%), decision breakdown, no-decision handling, on-time vs overdue, named reviewers and rubber-stamp/bulk-approve analytics.
example_artifact: e.g., a per-campaign completion report with reviewer and decision analytics

requirement: A certification revocation / remediation log: every revoke decision with decision timestamp, action timestamp, SLA met/missed, target system and closed-loop confirmation the entitlement was actually removed; privileged revocations on the tight SLA broken out.
example_artifact: e.g., a closed-loop revocation log with SLA attainment per decision

requirement: A reviewer attestation export: per-item attestation records with reviewer identity, accountable owner, decision, justification, timestamp and (for privileged) named sign-off, retained tamper-evidently.
example_artifact: e.g., an immutable per-item attestation export including last-reviewed dates

requirement: A versioned SoD ruleset / policy register where each rule has a business rationale, named owner, risk rating and the conflicting functions/entitlements it covers, with review dates demonstrating a living register.
example_artifact: e.g., a version-controlled SoD ruleset export with owners and review history

requirement: A SoD violation register recording per conflict the rule, affected identity, affected systems, risk rating, disposition, documented mitigating control, owner and next-review/expiry, traceable across scan cycles.
example_artifact: e.g., a violation register with documented specific mitigating controls and bounded exceptions

requirement: A request-time SoD block log: access requests that triggered an SoD rule, the decision (blocked/overridden), the named approver, justification and timestamp, across all provisioning channels including birthright and break-glass.
example_artifact: e.g., a request-time block/override log covering all provisioning channels

requirement: A role model document: role catalogue with role name, owner, contained entitlements, eligible population and business justification; business-vs-technical role mapping; and a coverage metric (percentage of users/entitlements explained by an approved role).
example_artifact: e.g., an owner-approved role model document plus a role-mining coverage metric

requirement: A request/approval audit trail: per-request record of requester, item, approver(s), decision, timestamp and business justification, queryable per user, per entitlement and per time window, with out-of-band grants logged as exceptions.
example_artifact: e.g., a request/approval audit-trail export with the enforced approval-path configuration

requirement: An entitlement right-sizing report flagging excess/unused/unexplained/over-broad entitlements with disposition (revoke/downscope/JIT/accept), plus a reduction trend across cycles demonstrating a program not a one-off purge.
example_artifact: e.g., a periodic right-sizing report with a standing-/excess-entitlement reduction trend

requirement: A governance attestation for emerging non-human governed objects: an inventory of agentic-AI agents and OAuth app registrations / consent grants with named owners, scoped least-privilege entitlements, high-risk-scope flags and a continuous (not point-in-time) attestation/revocation record.
example_artifact: e.g., an agent / OAuth consent-grant inventory with owner attribution and continuous-attestation evidence

requirement: An expiry / re-grant log: time-bound grants with their expiry, automatic removal at lapse with timestamp and SLA attainment, and re-request decisions recorded with approver, timestamp and justification, distinguishable from first grants and showing no silent auto-renewal.
example_artifact: e.g., a request-workflow export of expired-and-removed grants plus the renewal-decision audit trail

requirement: A time-bound coverage metric: the share of high-risk / SoD-relevant / contractor entitlements carrying a defined expiry versus perpetual grants, trended across cycles, with the migration backlog of standing access flagged by certification.
example_artifact: e.g., a periodic expiry-coverage dashboard with the perpetual-grant burn-down trend

requirement: The workflow configuration showing the requester-not-equal-approver rule (including delegation and out-of-office routing) plus a periodic self-approval audit report across all grants evidencing zero unremediated self-approvals, retained per evidence policy.
example_artifact: e.g., the approval-policy configuration export plus the latest self-approval audit report

requirement: Evidence that out-of-band entitlement edits — including an administrator changing their own access in an application console — are detected and alerted within a defined SLA, with a sample alert and its recorded disposition (revert, justify or escalate).
example_artifact: e.g., a detection rule for out-of-band self-edits plus a sample alert and disposition record

requirement: An unstructured-data repository register: per repository the named business owner, data classification, effective-access resolution (including nested groups and sharing links) and last owner certification date, with a coverage metric of registered versus discovered repositories.
example_artifact: e.g., a repository inventory export with owner, classification and certification-status columns plus the coverage trend

requirement: An open-access scan report over the unstructured-data estate detecting Everyone-type groups, anyone-with-link sharing and public buckets, with per-finding disposition (removed or accepted via a recorded time-bound exception with owner) traceable across scan cycles.
example_artifact: e.g., a periodic open-access scan output with remediation / exception dispositions

requirement: Inventory of autonomous agents with owner+purpose+tool-scope
example_artifact: Agent registry export

requirement: Agent entitlement recertification + drift-attestation log
example_artifact: Certification campaign + drift report

requirement: Orphan/owner-less agent detection + revocation report
example_artifact: Orphan-agent scan output
